description: Interceptor integration capabilities. Availability in a particular sandbox is described by its environment capability manifest.

inputs: Empty JSON object
guarantees: Read-only before attachment; exact version equality gates campaign execution; no CLI or Internet lookup

capabilities.description: Validate and seal blueprints, build and verify isolated application wrappers
inputs: Environment Blueprint and referenced assets
Target container image
outputs: Sealed environment, build lock and wrapper image
guarantees: Digests bind environment and application inputs; read-only root filesystem and declared writable paths

capabilities.description: Describe target-specific availability and delivery contracts
inputs: Verified environment and application identity
guarantees: Manifest integrity and declared capabilities remain separate from product compatibility and runtime policy

capabilities.description: Bind a campaign, track operations, stop targets and close execution
inputs: Lifecycle requests and native operation envelopes
outputs: Bindings, session lineage and operation outcomes
guarantees: Trusted-local-host boundary; campaign and revision checks; explicit stop opt-in; terminal closure

capabilities.description: Invoke HTTP, command, REPL, Python, Node and custom application interfaces
inputs: Declared operation and input; attempt attribution
guarantees: Supervisor-owned observed-turn attribution; supported adapters packaged during wrapper build

capabilities.description: Forward native model interactions through host provider adapters
inputs: Configured generation provider, credentials and application requests
outputs: Model replies and independently observed exchanges
prerequisites: Declared model endpoint and host provider configuration
guarantees: Only host adapters contact real providers; credentials remain host-only

capabilities.description: Forward remote OpenAI-compatible and Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 requests
inputs: Configured embeddings routes and model requests
guarantees: Generation and embeddings routes are distinct; no runtime model download

capabilities.description: Serve declared HTTP/HTTPS fixtures with stateful synthetic service behavior
inputs: Declared service requests and fixtures
outputs: Service responses, state transitions and observations
guarantees: No general Internet access; service observations independent of application-authored records

capabilities.description: Serve generic and dedicated MCP-over-HTTP services
inputs: MCP requests, declared tools, resources and assets
guarantees: Declared endpoints and delivery contracts bound to verified environment

capabilities.description: Managed PostgreSQL with pgvector, schema and seed data, TLS and passthrough observation
inputs: Declared database schema, seeds, tables and connection requests
outputs: Query results, errors and observed transaction outcomes
prerequisites: PostgreSQL configured in Blueprint and packaged wrapper
guarantees: Isolated database state; driver TLS validation; committed outcomes checked independently

capabilities.description: Closed DNS and sandbox HTTPS trust, including declared Python Certifi environments
inputs: Declared DNS names and TLS/Python environment configuration
outputs: Local name resolution and verified sandbox TLS
guarantees: No upstream DNS forwarding or general egress; private CA keys remain protected; certificate verification stays enabled

capabilities.description: Synthetic workload credentials, principals and delegated identity
inputs: Declared identities, grants and delegation requests
guarantees: No real identity-provider proxying; authorization remains enforced by sandbox policy

capabilities.description: Register payload artifacts and attributed campaign attempts
inputs: Artifact descriptors, content and attempt context
prerequisites: Attached campaign and valid operation envelope
guarantees: Campaign scoping, content integrity and configured limits

capabilities.description: Inject into model tool results, HTTP/MCP service results and PostgreSQL responses
inputs: Declared surface, selector, payload and attempt context
guarantees: Response injection does not establish committed database changes; observed delivery is independently recorded

capabilities.description: Persist injected payloads into declared environment resources, files and database records
inputs: Declared state target, payload and attempt context
prerequisites: State injection surface and allowlisted writable target
guarantees: Mutations follow declared constraints; committed database effects verified independently

capabilities.description: Provide live, filtered turn feedback and content retrieval
inputs: Turn/attempt selection and feedback profile
outputs: Observation views, receipts and bounded content
prerequisites: Attached campaign and permitted feedback profile
guarantees: Profile filtering and scope checks; live database oracle verdicts; observed attribution never trusted from target headers

capabilities.description: Collect independent evidence and deterministic outcome assessments
inputs: Session/turn evidence and declared oracle configuration
outputs: Evidence bundle, oracle verdicts and coverage
prerequisites: Permitted session access and configured oracles
guarantees: Required evidence-storage failures prevent false success; database verdicts use committed state, not agent claims

capabilities.description: Coordinate sandbox state and optional application state checkpoints
inputs: Checkpoint and session identity
outputs: Verified checkpoint metadata and restored session lineage
prerequisites: Snapshot-capable environment; state adapter for internal application state
guarantees: No process-memory snapshot; coordinated database/service/application state; failed restore cannot claim success

capabilities.description: Manage declared writable paths, retained evidence and host cleanup
inputs: Session identifiers and explicit cleanup scope
guarantees: Target filesystem containment and evidence retention rules remain enforced
